assertion_analysis.condition_to_fail: running_requests returns anything other than the largest rank count: a first-rank reduction gives 0 for the (0,4) case, a sum gives 4 for (0,0) and 2 for (4,2), and a zero-on-absence change gives 0 for the empty exposition.

cli._engine_running_requests stops delegating to lane.fetch_engine_metrics, because the monkeypatched lane.urllib.request.build_opener would no longer intercept the scrape and the call would read None from a real connection.
parse_lane_capacity stops routing its running field through the shared reduction, for example by restoring int(read('requests_running') or 0), which yields 0 for the absent-gauge exposition.
running_requests reports a number when the exposition carries a pool size but no running series; the recorded mutation making it return 0 reddens exactly this assertion.
parse_lane_capacity accepts an exposition with no running-request series instead of raising ValueError.
a failed scrape is reported as a running count of zero, or the drain's reader stops swallowing the fetch failure.
either consumer stops issuing the scrape the test counts, or issues it more than once per call.

call_sites: imas_ambix/agent/reload.py:117 (overlap drain poll loop, guarded by except (OSError, ValueError) at reload.py:118)

findings.text: follow-on: The except (OSError, ValueError) clause no longer covers the failures of the call it now wraps - lane.fetch_engine_metrics decodes Content-Encoding at imas_ambix/agent/lane.py:552-556, and gzip.decompress raises EOFError on a truncated body while zlib.decompress raises zlib.error, neither a subclass of OSError or ValueError - so a corrupt compressed scrape escapes the drain reader and reaches imas_ambix/agent/reload.py:117, whose own guard at reload.py:118 catches the same two types only, aborting an overlap whose replacement is already live and whose old job is then left uncancelled.

follow-on: Refusing an exposition with no valid running-request count turns three previously passing tests red at head - tests/test_agent_lane_counter_series.py::test_generation_tokens_sums_every_series, ::test_single_series_counter_is_unchanged and ::test_single_series_gauge_is_unchanged (3 failed, 41 passed in reader-consumers.log) - because those fixtures build a pool line with no running gauge and previously read running=0; the file is outside the node's declared write scope and the node correctly reported it under follow_ons, so the coordinator must update the fixtures before the merged tree is green.
